ECLYPSIUM_DEVICE_GROUP.description: Optional Eclypsium device group name to filter the device inventory (forwarded as the 'group' query parameter on /api/v1/devices). Omit to pull every device visible to the token.

name: eclypsium
title: Eclypsium
description: Eclypsium firmware security platform importer. Pulls devices via /api/v1/devices (optionally filtered by group) and per-device firmware findings via /api/v1/findings; emits one Faraday host per Eclypsium device with host.os set to the firmware vendor/model so firmware-targeted vulnerabilities land on a recognisable asset. Auth is token-based — set ECLYPSIUM_TOKEN (sent as Authorization: Bearer) and ECLYPSIUM_HOST to the platform base URL (e.g. https://your-tenant.eclypsium.cloud).
